g.text: 10k pull-ups on CMD and DAT0-3; ESD on all six lines.

g.desc: 10k pull-ups on CMD and DAT0-3; ESD on all six lines.

g.text: PCF85063ATL with 32.768 kHz crystal; VDD is diode-ORed from +3V3 and the CR2032.

g.desc: PCF85063ATL with 32.768 kHz crystal; VDD is diode-ORed from +3V3 and the CR2032.

g.text: I2C on SCL0/SDA0; INT on GPIO26. CLKOE tied low to save power.

g.desc: I2C on SCL0/SDA0; INT on GPIO26. CLKOE tied low to save power.

g.text: 2-pin +5 V fan header with a Schottky flyback diode. Always on.

g.desc: 2-pin +5 V fan header with a Schottky flyback diode. Always on.

g.text: All 28 CM4 GPIOs are brought out; GPIO26 also carries the RTC interrupt.

g.desc: All 28 CM4 GPIOs are brought out; GPIO26 also carries the RTC interrupt.

g.text: 2x20 Raspberry Pi header pinout. J_GPIO1 is the odd pins, J_GPIO2 the even pins.

g.desc: 2x20 Raspberry Pi header pinout. J_GPIO1 is the odd pins, J_GPIO2 the even pins.

g.text: CM4 Lite SD interface, 4-bit. U11 switches SD_VDD from SD_PWR_ON.

g.desc: CM4 Lite SD interface, 4-bit. U11 switches SD_VDD from SD_PWR_ON.

g.text: D2/D3 lanes are not connected on these 2-lane ports.

g.desc: D2/D3 lanes are not connected on these 2-lane ports.

g.text: SCL0/SDA0 shared with the RTC; CAM_GPIO drives camera power enable.

g.desc: SCL0/SDA0 shared with the RTC; CAM_GPIO drives camera power enable.

g.text: 22-pin FFC: CAM0 (2 lanes) and DSI0 (2 lanes).

g.desc: 22-pin FFC: CAM0 (2 lanes) and DSI0 (2 lanes).
